GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   D. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   C. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   C. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   D. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

10. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   B. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   D. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   B. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   B. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   B. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   C. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   C. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.

16. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   D. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Weathering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Wasting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Soils and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
